newsitem.title: UK: Guinness to tap dollar Eurobond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Guinness to tap dollar Eurobond - dealers.

text.p: Brewing group Guinness Plc is expected to tap the dollar Eurobond market on Thursday, syndicate officials said on Wednesday.
J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley were tipped as joint lead managers for the transaction. J.P. Morgan declined to comment while Morgan Stanley was not immediately available.
Terms of the deal were not yet clear, dealers said.
In April last year, Guinness launched a $200 million December 1999 bond via C.S. First Boston at a 25 basis point spread over the 5.0 percent 1999 U.S. Treasury.
It was now trading flat to Treasuries, dealers said.
In August, Moody's Investors Service downgraded Guinness senior unsecured debt to Aa3 from Aa2.
In March, Standard & Poor's Corp affirmed its AA- senior debt rating.
Guinness holds leading global positions in high-margin Scotch whisky and stout beer.
